Modular Scale Calculator

Generate a harmonious type scale from a base size and ratio — every step computed live with px values and a preview.

StepSizePreview

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your base font size (usually body text, e.g. 16px).
  2. Pick a scale ratio — 1.250 (major third), 1.618 (golden ratio) and more.
  3. Copy any step value; the preview shows the steps at real size.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is a modular scale?

A sequence of sizes where each step = base × ratioⁿ. Using one ratio keeps headings, subheads and body in visual harmony.

Which ratio should I pick?

1.125–1.200 for subtle UI type, 1.250–1.333 for editorial, 1.414–1.618 for dramatic display hierarchies.

How many steps are shown?

Six steps up and three down from the base, labeled like a type scale (e.g. step +3 ≈ h3 territory).
